_about: Task 8 self-correction (segment seg8b): what the model is told about its own mistakes. $-placeholders are filled by arcdemo/layout_prompt.py (string.Template).
repair: Line $n, "$line", has a problem: $problems. Write line $n again: the same $object, placed where it fits. Write only that one line.
review_intro: Check the room you wrote. Here it is, numbered, with the problems found:
review_instructions: Fix the problems with edits, one per line:
move <n> wall=<wall name> at=<at>      (a wall piece, to a wall)
move <n> x=<x> y=<y> facing=<north|east|south|west>      (a free piece)
Then write done. Change only what fixes a problem.
undone: Your edit "$edit" was undone: it made the room worse.
